scope: Schema compatibility and deterministic byte regression for canonical scan and assessment reports across JSON, Markdown, SARIF, CLI and Web parsing. This is engineering evidence, not formal accuracy, a real-project walkthrough, CLI beta publication or Issue #5 acceptance.
commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/report-stability.test.ts tests/reports.test.ts tests/scan.test.ts tests/assessment.test.ts tests/web-viewer.test.ts

checks.name: scan JSON schema
checks.expected: The generated canonical scan report validates against scan-report.schema.json.

checks.name: assessment JSON schema
checks.expected: The generated assessment report validates against assessment-report.schema.json.

checks.name: repeated rendering bytes
checks.expected: Repeated scan JSON, Markdown, SARIF, assessment JSON and assessment Markdown renderings are byte-identical.

checks.name: CLI and Web canonical semantics
checks.expected: Schema version, scanner version, target, snapshots, coverage and every finding ID, status, evidence, location and target are equal after the CLI JSON report is parsed by the Web model.

checks.name: SARIF finding and location projection
checks.expected: Every SARIF result preserves the canonical finding ID, status, evidence and one-based start line/column; SARIF 2.1.0 run properties preserve coverage.

surfaceDifferences: JSON retains the complete dependency graph and source inventory.
Markdown and SARIF intentionally project canonical findings and metadata rather than reproduce the complete JSON graph.
SARIF maps each canonical location to a relative URI and one-based region while retaining canonical evidence and identifiers in result properties.
Markdown applies presentation escaping; it does not alter canonical finding values.
limitations: The source-api input is an authored developer fixture and does not establish real-world dependency, API, replacement or missing-port accuracy.
The knowledge snapshot is used only to exercise deterministic assessment serialization; it does not provide reviewed compatibility guidance.
The regression does not replace a real authorized project walkthrough, an independent clean host, a public CLI beta or product-owner acceptance.
No runtime compatibility, SDK support or formal Issue #5 close condition is established.
